money.dialogDescription: Every number that is money carries its basis: where the figure came from. It never reads stronger than what was recorded.

gateway_observed.label: gateway_observed
gateway_observed.description: Oxagen's gateway saw the provider's response and priced its usage against the price book.

client_attested.label: client_attested
client_attested.description: The agent's harness reported the usage. Oxagen priced it but did not observe the call.

mixed.label: mixed
mixed.description: Part of this total was observed at the gateway and part was attested by a client.

estimated.label: estimated
estimated.description: No usage was recorded for part of this total, so it was estimated. Treat it as a lower bound.

unknown.label: basis not recorded
unknown.description: No basis was recorded for this figure.

gateway.label: gateway
gateway.description: Oxagen carried the model and tool calls and could enforce every decision.

harness.label: harness
harness.description: The harness hook enforced decisions; Oxagen did not carry the credential.

observe.label: observe
observe.description: Oxagen recorded the run but could not enforce anything.

unknown.label: not recorded
unknown.description: No enforcement tier was recorded for this run.

inspect.label: inspect
inspect.description: The recording has gaps: frames can be inspected, not played.

view.label: view
view.description: The run can be watched frame by frame.

fork.label: fork
fork.description: The run can be forked from any frame.

retry.label: retry
retry.description: The recording is complete enough to retry the run.

unknown.label: not recorded
unknown.description: No replay grade was recorded for this run.

flipped.label: flipped
flipped.description: The witness failed on the target and passed on the change.

failing.label: failing
failing.description: The witness still fails on the change.

unmoved.label: unmoved
unmoved.description: The witness gave the same result before and after.

unsatisfied.label: unsatisfied
unsatisfied.description: The oracle's conditions were not met.

tampered.label: tampered
tampered.description: The evidence was changed after it was recorded.

unverified.label: unverified
unverified.description: No witness ran, so nothing was proven.

waived.label: waived
waived.description: A person waived the proof requirement.

parked.label: parked for approval
parked.description: A call is waiting for a person to approve it.

pausing.label: pausing · next boundary
pausing.description: The run pauses at the next step boundary.

resuming.label: resuming
resuming.description: The run is resuming from its pause.

sealed.label: sealed
sealed.description: The run ended and its recording is sealed.

halted.label: halted
halted.description: The run was stopped by a person or a policy.

compacted.label: compacted
compacted.description: The run's frames were compacted under the retention policy.

unenrolled.label: unenrolled
unenrolled.description: The agent is registered but not enrolled.

active.label: active
active.description: The agent is enrolled and may run.

suspended.label: suspended
suspended.description: The agent may not start runs until it is reinstated.

retired.label: retired
retired.description: The agent is retired. Its record stays.

allow.label: allowed
allow.description: Allowed wherever a grant reaches this version.

require_approval.label: needs approval
require_approval.description: A person must approve each call.

mandate.label: mandate + approval
mandate.description: A mandate is required, and its own rule decides when a person approves.

killed.label: kill switch
killed.description: A kill switch stops every call.

read.label: Read-only
read.description: Observes and returns. Changes nothing anywhere.

query.label: Data query
query.description: Bulk read from a store. Read-only, but the result set is the exfiltration and the cost.

record.label: Record write
record.description: Creates or updates a record in a system of work. Reversible by another write.

message.label: Messaging & authoring
message.description: Speaks to people on the organization's behalf. A sent message cannot be unsent.

file.label: File mutation
file.description: Writes, edits, moves or deletes files in a workspace or a drive.

exec.label: Code execution
exec.description: Runs a command or a program. Its effect is whatever the sandbox allows.

vcs.label: Source control
vcs.description: Changes code history: branches, pull requests, merges, releases, repositories.

infra.label: Infrastructure
infra.description: Deploys, scales, pauses or reconfigures a running system.

access.label: Access & identity
access.description: Grants, shares, rotates or revokes access. Widens what every later call can reach.

finance.label: Financial control
finance.description: Moves funds or commits spend. Never callable without a mandate.

constraint.label: constraint
constraint.description: A hard boundary: require or forbid

fact.label: fact
fact.description: A checkable claim about the world

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: When there is something to show, it appears here.

notBacked.title: Not recorded yet
notBacked.body: Oxagen does not record this yet. It arrives with milestone {milestone} (backend gap {gap}).
notBacked.bodySpecDecision: Oxagen does not record this yet. It waits on a spec decision (backend gap {gap}).

denied.title: You do not have access
denied.body: Your roles do not include {permission}. An organization owner can grant it; the grant is a governed action and lands in the audit record.

error.title: This could not load
error.body: Mission Control answered {status} {code}. Nothing was changed, and runs kept recording while this page was down.

formDialog.error: That did not work ({code}). Nothing was changed.
